purpose: Judge photographic preservation, convincing handmade paper construction, clean cut edges, visible pencil texture, and edits limited to clothing, bag, and shoes.

examples.title: Explain the paper-outfit trick in one glance
whyItWorks: The title, result, and single original-photo inset explain the transformation immediately
The face, pose, skin, lighting, street, and shadows remain photographic
The dress and bag read as physical paper cutouts laid over the real photo

examples.title: Keep a sunny travel portrait completely real
whyItWorks: The source inset proves the person, pose, terrace, and sea stay recognizable
Pencil marks and white paper texture appear only on the outfit and accessories
Cut edges and layered pieces feel handmade instead of digitally recolored

examples.title: Let the background keep all of its detail
whyItWorks: The face, hair, body, architecture, and coast remain unchanged
The gingham top, skirt, and shoes share one coherent paper treatment
The effect stays readable without flattening the photograph

examples.title: Carry the treatment across a full outfit
whyItWorks: The subject, ice cream, car, street, and lighting remain photographic
Top, shorts, and bag use matching drawn texture and crisp cut edges
The paper pieces sit over the body while respecting pose and silhouette

examples.title: Make layered separates feel handmade
whyItWorks: The portrait and doorway remain realistic and recognizable
Top and skirt use distinct paper colors without changing the person
White outlines and pencil strokes make the physical overlay legible

examples.title: Preserve a soft candid pose
whyItWorks: The face, skin, arms, body, wall, plants, and light remain photographic
Each garment and accessory becomes its own cut-paper object
The new pieces still follow the original pose and proportions

examples.title: Keep dramatic architecture outside the edit
whyItWorks: The person, pose, hall, exhibits, and golden light stay real
The floral dress gains visible paper texture and hand-drawn pigment
The limited edit makes the result feel like a tactile fashion collage
